title: Best Friends!
description: A modpack used for the Best Friends! server often seen in livestreams from NotAviantics, KalenDoesTwitch, and more.
body:
Modpack for Best Friends! server commonly seen in livestreams from NotAviantics, KalenDoesTwitch, and more. The modpack is expansive while emphasing adding on to vanilla minecraft and creating a fun experience with broad appeal.

# Who is this modpack for?
This modpack is for anyone! It is used and updated primarily for a live-streamed server, but this modpack is made with care and dedication so that anyone can enjoy it.
# What does this modpack offer?
 This modpack aims to be Vanilla+ in nature, staying true to the core mechanics while adding quality of life improvements, natural generation mods, food additions, and more. Some of the main features include BiomesOPlenty, Seren Seasons, VoiceChat, and Farmer's Delight.
# Why should you want to download this modpack?
Simply put, reglardless of if you are looking for a singleplayer experience or starting a world with friends, this is the modpack for you. Be blown away by immersive detail while never forgetting that you're playing Minecraft at heart. So the question becomes, why haven't you downloaded it yet?
